title: Cops and Robbers: A $\times$-homotopy Invariant Variant
summary: Cops and Robbers is a pursuit-evasion game played on graphs, of which many variants have been developed and studied. We introduce a variant of this game, "Sneaky-Active Cops and Robbers", where all cops and robber must move on their turn, and where the robber is allowed to move onto a cop position without being captured. We show that for reflexive graphs, this game is equivalent to the classical cops and robbers and that the cop number for a graph is invariant under $\times$-homotopy equivalence.
